children: NeoVolta Inc. reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $13.33M, up from $8.43M a year earlier, while the company posted a net loss of $21.47M and diluted loss per share of $(0.55) for the year, versus a net loss of $5.03M and diluted loss per share of $(0.15) in FY 2025.
Revenue was $13.33M for FY 2026, compared with $8.43M in FY 2025; YoY change 58.2%.
Net income was a loss of $21.47M for FY 2026, compared with a loss of $5.03M in FY 2025; change worse by $16.44M.
Diluted EPS was a loss of $(0.55) for FY 2026, versus $(0.15) for FY 2025.
Revenue growth to $13.33M was driven by expansion of sales channels beyond Southern California into new markets.
Management is shifting the brand from a storage manufacturer to an integrated energy solutions provider, accelerating R&D and new product development.
NeoVolta formed an 80%‑owned joint venture (NVP) to develop a phased utility‑scale battery plant in Georgia; initial capital has been deployed and pilot production is expected in FY2027 Q1.
The company acquired Neubau assets and has stockpiled key China‑sourced components amid tariff uncertainty to support a planned production scale‑up.
Early 2026 federal tax changes dampened demand, and the company has rapidly expanded sales channels outside its traditional local installer market.
